as_told.title: Mario flashes his lights at a light in the sky and it flashes back
as_told.place_text: November 1 launch control facility, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

plain: Mario Woods, a guard at a nuclear missile control post called November-1 in the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that in 1977 he saw a light hanging still over the prairie. He says he flicked his own lights off and on three times, and after a minute or so the distant light blinked back the same way, which sent shivers up his spine because it meant, as he put it, they could see him. He tells it as the lead-up to the abduction he says he and fellow airmen went through.
